items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: No, I don't remember him well.

ctx.x: Yeah, those fellas used to have, back in that time, they had a lot of old musicians, you know, like Jimmy Brown, that fella's name, used to play there. Jimmy Brown, another dude they used to play over here at the cooperators hall. I can't think of his name. What'd you see at that time? It was, it was all, oh, you wasn't, you wasn't in the city then.
You remember Billy Marrero? Lawrence Marrero's father?
No, I don't remember him well.
